name: Brine Frost
description: Strike with a hand wet in cold brine that freezes on contact with the target's sleeve.

name: Wet Rime
description: Draw water from the air and flash-freeze it into a sheet before the chest.

name: Dew Sense
description: Read the dew condensing on stone and cloth to learn where warmth and breath lie.

name: Skin Ice
description: Let a film of water on the skin set hard on command to ready the body for a blow.

name: Frozen Whip
description: Lash a whip of water and freeze it mid-swing so the tip lands as hard ice.

name: Slush Binding
description: Drench an opponent's legs in water and freeze it to a hard cast around them.

name: Thaw Mend
description: Wash an ally's wound in clean water and chill it just enough to stanch the flow and seal the skin.

name: Cleansing Melt
description: Wash a poisoned limb in water and freeze the poison out of it as a crust to be brushed away.

name: Hardwater Lance
description: Compress water into a rod and freeze it to the hardness of steel in the instant of throwing.

name: Glass Flow
description: Run a sheet of water across the ground and freeze it into slick glass in the same breath.

name: Frozen Surge
description: Surge water over a wide front and freeze the whole sheet in a heartbeat round every foot.

name: Stillwater Verdict
description: streams: Ice + Water; weave water and ice into one body of rime-bound flow that drowns and freezes a foe in the same instant.

name: Ember Rime
description: Strike with one hand burning and one hand frosted so the skin cracks from two sides.

name: Swap Palm
description: Pass heat and cold between the palms to find the even point between them.

name: Twin Temper
description: Raise a sheet of cold on one side and heat on the other so blows are worn away on either face.

name: Ember Pellet
description: Throw a pellet white with frost outside and red with fire at its core.

name: Crack Edge
description: Strike a heated plate or blade with a cold palm so that it cracks across.

name: Thaw Bind
description: Wet the opponent's sleeves with flame-warmed water and freeze them hard to the arms.

name: Tempered Mend
description: Warm an ally's chilled wound and cool its fever in turns until the flesh is firm and even.

name: Fever Break
description: Burn out an infection with a warm pulse and chill the fever behind it to leave the blood clean.

name: Vapor Spear
description: Cast a jet of boiling vapor that freezes into a spear of ice as it reaches the target.

name: Shatter Pulse
description: Heat the air near a group and chill it in the same moment so cloth and bone crack alike.

name: Boundary Ward
description: Hold the line where heat meets cold before the body so any blow that crosses it is torn by the change.

name: Boundary Break
description: Strike the line where heat meets cold on an opponent's guard and shatter it from within.

name: Cinderfrost
description: streams: Ice + Fire; drive a column of flame and a column of ice together at one point so that their clash tears a blast through the guard.

name: Twofold Cleave
description: streams: Ice + Fire; split a stance with one stroke whose one edge burns and the other freezes so the guard's qi cannot choose which to meet.

name: Glass Skin
description: Settle a layer of water on the skin and let it clear into glass-like ice for even strength.

name: Mirror Chill
description: Turn a blow aside with a polished sheet of ice that is still wet at its face.

name: Clear Touch
description: Touch the target with a palm of clear glass-ice that cracks into the skin.

name: Glass Bind
description: Cast water on both legs and freeze it to a clear shell that no kick can break.

name: Water Ward
description: Hold a thick curtain of water and freeze its outer half to catch heavy blows in the middle.

name: Clear Mend
description: Bathe an ally's wound with clean cold water that sets to a thin seal over it.

name: Clean Freeze
description: Freeze a tainted wash on an ally's skin and peel it away with the taint locked inside.

name: Glass Lance
description: Freeze a thrown jet of water into a clear lance of glass in mid-flight.

name: Mirror Sheet
description: Hold a wide sheet of glass-ice that turns a beam of qi and sends it away at the angle it came.

name: Perfect Reflection
description: Stand behind a sheet of glass-ice so clear that attacks strike only the image of the user and are thrown back.

name: Mirrorwater Surge
description: streams: Ice + Water; surge a wave of water and freeze its crest to a mirror so the whole wave strikes while the foe sees only himself in it.
